name: village-panorama
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide 3D miniature rural farming game exploration panorama, landscape 1536x1024. Natural mossy stone, warm morning sun, soft atmospheric depth, physically realistic materials, polished handcrafted diorama matching reference rural Japanese village aesthetic. No text, no icons, no HUD, no characters. Continuous edge to edge landscape.

name: duck-swim
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: horizontal four-frame sprite strip for a farming game, 1536x1024 transparent background. EXACTLY four identical size white domestic ducks arranged at four evenly spaced columns, all facing three-quarter left in isometric miniature realistic 3D style. Each duck is FLOATING with lower belly submerged: low horizontal body, folded wings, orange bill, no feet or legs visible at all, no standing poses. Four subtle sequential swim poses with neck slightly moving, gentle small transparent turquoise oval wake ring around each body, no solid water patch. Same scale and identical anatomy in every frame. Each full silhouette contained in its own column, large transparent gutters, no overlap, no text, no other objects.

name: village-people
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 6 separated full-body character sprites for a farming game, transparent background, landscape 1536x1024. A precise 3 columns by 2 rows contact sheet with 6 clearly different rural Asian 3D miniature farmers, one per equal cell, ample transparent margin around each silhouette. All standing relaxed facing three-quarter LEFT, hands at sides, feet aligned at bottom of each cell. Same art style and camera. All are BALD (smooth bare head so game hair and hats can be layered), no hat. Neutral pale light grey simple long sleeve shirt, dark brown trousers, sandals. Row1: (1) slim youthful boy round cheeks large friendly eyes; (2) youthful girl round face gentle eyes, petite body; (3) tall broad-shouldered adult muscular farmer square face thick eyebrows. Row2: (4) short elderly man prominent grey mustache wrinkled smiling face and stocky body; (5) tall slender adult woman elegant oval face, distinctly feminine proportions; (6) small playful child girl with very round head rosy cheeks freckles and short body. Realistic detailed skin and cloth, stylized appealing miniature proportions, exquisite rendered lighting, physically realistic materials. No tools, no baskets, no hair, no hats, no plinths, no backgrounds, no text. Six separate silhouettes, never touch each other.
